exposure: Birthplace (inborn: born in a reference center; outborn: born outside a reference center)
outcome: time to abdominal wall closure surgery
time to weaning from mechanical ventilation
cohort: 144 patients admitted to three hospitals in a state in Brazil's southeastern region with a diagnosis of gastroschisis between January 2000 to December 2018.
finding: Outborn patients with gastroschisis experienced several disadvantages, including a higher likelihood of no antenatal diagnosis and longer times for surgical and feeding procedures and mechanical ventilation, but these did not result in differences in mortality rates or length of hospital stay compared to inborn patients.
mod_finding: Outborn patients with gastroschisis had higher rates of vaginal delivery compared to inborn patients.
